title: It was the smartest and dumbest of times
A Storm of TESLA Cybercabs
lyrics:
(Verse 1 — The Launch)

Austin woke up gold on the third of September
No livestream, just the future rolling in
Forty-five machines with no hands on a wheel
Butterfly doors lifting like a storm about to begin
Tesla said the future arrived in Austin, TEXAS
First car built from the ground for unsupervised drive
Phone in your pocket and the door knows your name
Step in, buckle up, tap Start Ride — you’re alive  

(Chorus)

A storm of TESLA Cybercabs, gold across the sky
No steering wheel stirring, no driver in sight
A storm of Cybercabs, coming down the line
First-class lounge on wheels at a coach-class price
A storm of Cybercabs, flooding every street
Camera eyes wide open, no LiDAR they need
A storm of Cybercabs — the people’s cab is here
Safer, cleaner, louder, the golden era is near  

(Verse 2 — The Machine)

Two seats? three? that’s all you need, lounge instead of a cockpit
No pedals, no mirrors, no glove ..... box, hood stays locked
Matte gold body, light-bars that change color when they find you
22-inch theater screen running Unreal, music, games, and Grok


Eight cameras seeing everything, neural net calling the shots
Front-wheel drive, 219 horses, motor with rare earths

Forty-eight kilowatt-hours, almost three hundred miles
Lightest Tesla ever — three thousand one hundred thirteen pounds
Wireless charge, no port, roll into the hub and drink
Automated clean between rides so the next guest finds it neat  

(Chorus)
A storm of Cybercabs, gold across the sky
No steering wheel stirring, no driver in sight
A storm of Cybercabs, coming down the line
First-class lounge on wheels at a coach-class price  

(Verse 3 — Inside the Ride)
Forty-three point four inches of legroom, stretch out and breathe
Bench at wheelchair height, Braille on the buttons, service dog at your feet
Trunk swallows two checked bags and two carry-ons easy
Two-twenty pounds, stroller, wheelchair — twenty cubic feet

Doors rise like wings when your phone gets close
Close themselves when the belts click — auto-tighten, no slack
Climate and seats remember your profile from the last ride
USB-C in the armrest, independent recline on each side

Stop button between the dome lights if you need the world to pause
Mechanical release if danger’s real — it pulls over or holds the lane
Cabin camera checks you’re safe, then hunts for lost keys and crumbs
Radar knows who’s sitting so the airbags know exactly what to do  

(Bridge — Safety & Smarts)
Engineered to be the safest car they ever put on the road
Detects sirens, emergency lights, first-responder hands in the air
External mics and speakers so support can talk without opening a door

Yields, pulls over, follows cones — Level 4 inside the geofence
Dynamic pricing rising with demand
But they promised first-class feeling at a coach-class fare
Starlink V5 coming soon — 4K video even where the cell towers fail
More time back, more life back, the streets won’t be the same  

(Verse 4 — The Storm Grows)
Production born at Giga Texas, cycle times chasing five to ten seconds
Motor eighteen percent smaller, twenty-five percent lighter, still the range
Efficiency that drinks almost nothing — urban miles on a whisper

China will see it mid-September, displays in Beijing and Shanghai
Not for sale there yet — just the shape of what’s coming
Fleet buyers can already raise a hand
Democratizing clean transport, the people’s cab on every corner
A lounge on wheels with a great TV and epic sound
That’s what Elon said while the gold dust settled on Austin  

(Final Chorus — Bigger)
A storm of Cybercabs, gold across the sky
No steering wheel stirring, no driver in sight
A storm of Cybercabs, coming down the line

First-class lounge on wheels at a coach-class price
A storm of Cybercabs, flooding every street
Camera eyes wide open, no LiDAR they need
A storm of Cybercabs — the people’s cab is here
Safer, cleaner, louder — the golden era is here  

(Outro)
’Twas the night before Cybercab
Not a steering wheel stirring
Nor a driver in sight
Now the storm is on the road
And the future just arrived.  

Can you hear me?
Can you see me?
Can you feel me?

title: CODE THE CODER
lyrics:
Open the file.

One more function.

Don’t overthink it.  Type it out.

Save it now.

Run it once.

See what it does.


Keep coding.

You can do it.

Test it now.

Load it. Watch it.

Fix the small thing.

Then the next thing.

Keep coding.

You’re still in it.

That’s just data.

Read the stack.

Change one line.  Compile again.

Wait a second.

Green is coming.

Or close enough.

Test it now.

Load it. Watch it.

Commit the part that works.

Leave a comment.

Keep coding.

You’re still in it.Bridge
